proposals: PNGRB should require every CGD entity to publish a station-wise list of its CNG stations with coordinates and station type — mother, online, daughter or daughter booster, so the cost split this post describes can be mapped outlet by outlet instead of discussed only in general.

IOCL, BPCL and HPCL should add a field to their published retail-outlet registers showing whether each outlet dispenses CNG and whether it is pipeline-connected or cascade-fed, so the 82,000-outlet map can show which dots are also part of the city-gas network.

PNGRB should publish CNG station counts for each of the 307 geographical areas every quarter, so coverage can be tracked against a current figure rather than the 5,665 stations reported as of March 2023.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publish the list of retail outlets receiving compressed biogas under SATAT, with monthly volumes, so the claimed displacement of fossil CNG by CBG at the retail layer can be measured rather than assumed.
